item.title: [Feature Request] GUI mode lacks permission configuration equivalent to CLI's bypass_permissions mode
item.body:
## Description

### Functional Gap
Trae CLI provides `bypass_permissions` permission mode (see docs: https://www.volcengine.com/docs/86677/2227872) 
that skips all tool invocation permission checks.

However, in **GUI mode (IDE)**, even with ALL of the following settings enabled:
- Auto-run MCP: ✅ Enabled
- Auto-run commands: Set to "Always auto-run"
- Sandbox mode: Set to "Always run outside sandbox"

**Terminal commands are still intercepted by the Shell security layer and flagged as "high-risk commands"**, 
requiring manual confirmation before execution.

### Reproduction Steps
1. Navigate to Settings > Conversation Flow > Auto-run
2. Enable all auto-run options at maximum permissions
3. Execute any standard file operation command, e.g.:
   ```powershell
   out-file -encoding utf8 "$env:temp\test.txt"
   ```
   or
   ```bash
   cp file1.txt file2.txt
   ```
4. Observe system warning: "检测到高风险命令...运行命令可能会带来严重后果"

### Expected vs Actual
| Behavior | CLI (`bypass_permissions`) | GUI (Current) |
|----------|-------------------------------|---------------|
| File operations | Executes directly | Shows confirmation dialog |
| Git operations | Executes directly | Some are intercepted |
| Long-running Agent tasks | No intervention needed | Requires frequent confirmation |
| User control | Configurable via config file | No equivalent option |

### Suggestion
Please consider adding any of the following options for GUI mode:

**Option A**: Add an advanced toggle **"Disable Shell Security Interception"** 
in Settings > Conversation Flow > Auto-run  
**Option B**: Make "Always auto-run" truly bypass all checks 
(consistent with CLI's `bypass_permissions`)  
**Option C**: Provide a `trae_gui.json` config file for advanced users to customize security policies

### Use Cases
This feature would significantly improve:
- Long-duration autonomous Agent tasks
- Automated CI/CD pipeline operations
- Power user workflows for command-line-savvy developers

## Environment
- OS: Windows 11 / macOS / Linux
- Trae Version: v3.3.x
- Mode: IDE (GUI)

---

## Additional Notes:
- This is a functional gap between GUI and CLI implementations
- The current behavior prevents "set-and-forget" long-running agent scenarios
- Not blocking critical usage, but significantly affects UX for automation-heavy workflows
- Related docs: https://www.volcengine.com/docs/86677/1964123 , https://www.volcengine.com/docs/86677/2129092
